name: Paloma Ibarra
location: Kessler Row — arms dealers and augmentation clinics, near Ashland and Chicago Ave
description:
Paloma Ibarra is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 44, his face is memorable in a profession that rewards forgettability, and he has learned to compensate. The chrome is visible — wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation — and he makes no effort to hide it.

Before the runner life, he worked corporate — low-tier security, the kind that teaches you exactly how the system's defenses fail. He works as a ghost out of Kessler Row, taking contracts that match his skills and his risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

Paloma Ibarra has survived long enough in the runner game to be either very good or very lucky, and he cultivates ambiguity on the topic.

core_fears: Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
That they're fundamentally alone and connection is just a vulnerability
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
Power — enough leverage that nobody ever threatens them again
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
coping_mechanisms: Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Mistakes loyalty for weakness in others and cynicism for strength in themselves
Cannot recognize when they're being manipulated by someone who genuinely seems to care
psychology.secret: Kenji Granlund-Tawiah is terrified of deep net diving but has built their reputation on it. Uses black-market AI to handle the heavy lifting while taking credit.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and disarming — sounds like a neighbor until the content registers.
verbal_tics: Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "Clean means no witnesses, no evidence, no questions. That's three things. I charge for each."
"The target will stop breathing at the specified time. What you do with that information is your concern."

story_hooks: Kenji Granlund-Tawiah intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Kenji Granlund-Tawiah's reputation — and a price for silence
Kenji Granlund-Tawiah is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
narrative_function: Kenji Granlund-Tawiah functions as a connector — his work puts him in contact with multiple factions, classes, and agendas. Stories involving him naturally cross boundaries between districts, tiers, and moral categories.
augmentations: Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation. Smartgun link in right forearm — interfaces directly with compatible weapons
daily_life: Wakes early, runs maintenance on gear, checks dead drops and message boards for contracts. Eats when convenient, sleeps when possible. The days between jobs are spent maintaining contacts, updating equipment, and performing the low-grade paranoia that passes for self-care in the runner community.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews; The Glass Ladder

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: augmentation dependency — performance drops sharply if chrome malfunctions
overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Never works with the same crew twice in a row — pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Never discusses active contracts with anyone not directly involved
Will abandon a job if the intel was deliberately falsified — being set up violates the contract
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Keeps a physical paper notebook — no digital record of personal thoughts
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out

physical_description.heritage: Complex Pan-Global blend: Hispanic/Latin American foundation (35.6%) mixed with substantial East Asian (26.0%), South Asian (25.3%), and Sub-Saharan African (13.1%) ancestry. Bone structure reflects this four-way synthesis — East Asian orbital structure and cheekbone prominence balanced by broader South Asian nasal architecture and African lip fullness. The genetic admixture creates striking dimensional facial geometry: rounded East Asian face shape softened by Latin American warmth, deepened by African and South Asian richness. A truly borderless phenotype that defies simple categorization.
physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled, built low and wide through the shoulders and hips — engineered for leverage and impact absorption rather than height. No excess fat; every kilogram is functional mass.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading through the sides
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped and practical, maintained with military precision
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, alert and constantly scanning
physical_description.skin_tone: Rich warm brown with complex undertone interplay — golden warmth from East Asian and Hispanic/Latin American heritage, deepened and enriched by South Asian and Sub-Saharan African admixture. Dimensional coloration that shifts warm to amber in sunlight, warmer still under warm artificial light. Variegated with subtle depth across cheekbones and jawline.
physical_description.complexion: Broad-structured face reflecting Pan-Global ancestry: prominent rounded cheekbones with fuller definition from South Asian and African heritage, squared jaw with slight softness from Hispanic/Latin American influence, East Asian orbital structure creating slightly hooded eye placement. Wide nasal bridge with slightly flared nostrils — signature of African and South Asian blending. Full lips with defined cupid's bow. Minimal grooming beyond function — no jewelry, no vanity. A thin scar runs from his left temple to his cheekbone, pale against his skin. His eyes are set deep and perpetually tired; the kind of tiredness that comes from chronic hypervigilance rather than lack of sleep.
distinguishing_marks: Thin pale scar running from left temple diagonally down to cheekbone — old injury, expertly healed
Chemical burn scarring on the right side of his neck, partially hidden by collar — discolored and mottled, approximately 3cm diameter
Tattoo on left forearm: intricate circuit-board pattern in black ink, older work, starting to blur with age
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Right forearm shows obvious chrome plating and mechanical articulation around the wrist and hand — smartgun link hardware visible as recessed ports and connector interfaces along the forearm. Reflective neural-link ports at the base of his skull, visible when his hair is wet. The wired reflexes system creates subtle musculature distortion across his upper arms and shoulders — the augmentation sits just under the skin, creating an uncanny smoothness and slight luminescence under certain light.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion. His weight is distributed low, center of gravity dropped slightly as if perpetually braced for impact. He favors his left side, trusting the right arm's augmented reflexes for reactive work. His eyes move constantly, scanning exits and threats before his body shifts. When still, he appears coiled rather than relaxed.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 utilitarian: reinforced cargo pants in matte black with internal holster stitching, worn synthetic leather jacket with oversized pockets and internal webbing, subdued colors (grays, blacks, dark greens). No logos or corporate branding — anonymity is the goal. Boots are serious — steel-toed, scuffed, maintained for function over appearance. A single piece of genuine hardware: a worn steel watch with a cracked face, kept for unknown sentimental reasons.
